title.en: Chapter 25 — I Strike the Jolly Roger

sentences.en: I climbed onto the ship by the rope.
On the deck I found two men, one dead.
The other was named Israel Hands and was wounded.

sentences.ar: قال لي: جيب لي نبيذ وبساعدك.
sentences.en: He said to me: bring me wine and I will help you.
I took down the black pirate flag.

sentences.ar: قلت له: أنا هلق كابتن هالسفينة.
sentences.en: I said to him: I am now the captain of this ship.
